summary: A Russian Shahed drone struck a passenger train in Odesa region killing the driver and assistant, while Ukraine recovered 261 bodies of fallen soldiers in a recent exchange. Russian forces advanced near Markov as massive drone waves targeted at least nine Ukrainian regions overnight. The SBU uncovered a 14-agent Russian network hunting for F-16 and Mirage 2000 jets near Ukrainian airbases.
key_points: Russian Shahed drone hit passenger train in Odesa region killing two crew members; 340 passengers evacuated unharmed. (Source: @UkraineNow/83406)
Ukraine repatriated 261 bodies of likely Ukrainian servicemen; Russia received 24 bodies in exchange. (Source: @UkraineNow/83403, @ukr_leaks_eng/32421)
Russian forces advanced in Markov area per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23737)

Massive drone waves launched overnight targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, Chernihiv, Poltava regions. (Source: @kpszsu/72692, @mon1tor_ua/70183, @eRadarrua/105298)
SBU uncovered 14-agent network recruiting spotters near aviation infrastructure to hunt F-16 and Mirage 2000 jets. (Source: @UkraineNow/83413)
Russia plans to abolish border zones with occupied Ukrainian territories in Rostov, Voronezh regions and Crimea. (Source: @UkraineNow/83410)
Germany ends temporary protection for Ukrainian conscription-age men who didn't fulfill military duty; Czechia also denying protection. (Source: @UkraineNow/83415)
Russian strikes damaged Fozzy Group distribution centers on Aug 5; full logistics restoration planned by Aug 24. (Source: @UkraineNow/83405)

sections.executive_summary: A Russian Shahed drone struck a passenger train in Odesa region killing the driver and assistant, while Ukraine recovered 261 bodies of fallen soldiers in a recent exchange. Russian forces advanced near Markov as massive drone waves targeted at least nine Ukrainian regions overnight. The SBU uncovered a 14-agent Russian network hunting for F-16 and Mirage 2000 jets near Ukrainian airbases.

points: Zelensky reported DSU liberated 745 sq km January-August on Oleksandrivsk direction, retaking 26 villages across Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia oblasts with Russian losses at least 9,550 killed. (Source: @UkraineNow/83394)
SBU exposed 14-person Russian agent network using Lviv aviation blogger to recruit spotters near airbases targeting F-16 and Mirage 2000; blocked 4 channels and 10 groups. (Source: @UkraineNow/83413)
Ukraine returned remains of OUN leader Yevhen Konovalets from Netherlands for reburial at National Military Memorial Cemetery with state honors. (Source: @UkraineNow/83407)
Ukraine proposed new peace proposals and Black Sea ceasefire to Russia; presented to US but didn't receive expected Trump support per Zelensky. (Source: @UkraineNow/83416, @ukr_leaks_eng/32419)
425th Separate Assault Battalion "Skelya" (fought in Bakhmut, Pokrovsk directions) transferred under operational command of Azov Corps. (Source: @UkraineNow/83412)
Civilian exchange at Belarus-Ukraine border: 8 returned to Russia, 7 to Ukraine including pensioners and 25-year-old man. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32440)
Russian MoD claimed strikes on fuel tanks and military cargo equipment in Odesa port, and Ukrainian patrol boat in Ochakiv port, Mykolaiv region. (Source: @tass_agency/390169)

FSB plans to cancel border zones between occupied Ukrainian territories and Russian regions (Rostov, Voronezh, Crimea), moving border regime to external boundaries of occupied areas. (Source: @UkraineNow/83410)

Russian forces launched multiple Shahed and UAV waves overnight Aug 13 targeting at least 9 Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, Chernihiv, Poltava. (Source: @kpszsu/72692, @mon1tor_ua/70183, @eRadarrua/105298)
Ballistic missile threat: Iskander-M launch possible from Taganrog, Rostov region per monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70179)
Russian side transferred 261 bodies of deceased military personnel to Ukraine in exchange; received 24 bodies. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32421)
Lavrov stated Russia will independently choose targets for response to Western "robbery and piracy," not necessarily in same waters. (Source: @tass_agency/390182)
DeepState map shows Russian forces advanced in Markov area (likely Donetsk region). (Source: @DeepStateUA/23737)
Ukrainian DSU offensive on Oleksandrivsk direction liberated 745 sq km Jan-Aug, retaking 26 villages across Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia oblasts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83394)
Russian losses on this sector at least 9,550 killed per Zelensky. (Source: @UkraineNow/83394)
425th Separate Assault Battalion "Skelya" (fought in Bakhmut, Pokrovsk directions) now under Azov Corps operational command. (Source: @UkraineNow/83412)
Russian jet UAVs and Shaheds targeted Chernihiv region: 5 UAVs near Ripky/Horodnya, 1 toward Sosnytsia; 2 guided UAVs toward Sedniv. (Source: @eRadarrua/105248, @eRadarrua/105254)
Multiple UAVs entered Sumy region from north; jet UAVs detected on eastern Sumy region heading west. (Source: @kpszsu/72690, @eRadarrua/105260)
Kharkiv region targeted by jet UAVs from north and northwest; UAVs from Chernihiv region along state border toward Kharkiv. (Source: @kpszsu/72692, @eRadarrua/105260)
Ballistic missile threat: potential Iskander-M launch from Taganrog, Rostov region toward northern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70179)
Russian Shahed struck passenger train in Odesa region killing driver and assistant; 340 passengers evacuated unharmed. (Source: @UkraineNow/83406)
Russian MoD claimed strikes on fuel tanks and military cargo equipment in Odesa port, and Ukrainian patrol boat in Ochakiv port, Mykolaiv region. (Source: @tass_agency/390169)
UAVs launched from Kherson region toward Mykolaiv; from Black Sea toward Odesa; from south toward Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @kpszsu/72641)
Jet UAVs detected in northern Odesa region heading west toward Berezivka; eastern Odesa region UAVs heading west. (Source: @kpszsu/72664, @kpszsu/72642)
Russian strikes on Fozzy Group distribution centers (including Silpo, Fora supermarkets) on Aug 5 disrupted supply chains; full restoration by Aug 24 planned. (Source: @UkraineNow/83405)

Overnight Aug 13 massive Russian drone campaign: Shaheds and jet UAVs launched toward at least 9 regions (Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, Chernihiv, Poltava). (Source: @kpszsu/72692, @mon1tor_ua/70183, @eRadarrua/105298)
Two Shaheds attacked Kyiv region heading to Zhytomyr; minimum two more "Bandarol" UAVs entering Zhytomyr region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70182, @mon1tor_ua/70185)
Chernihiv region: 5 UAVs near Ripky/Horodnya, 1 on Sosnytsia; 2 guided UAVs toward Sedniv; 1 from Ripky toward Chernihiv suburbs. (Source: @eRadarrua/105248, @eRadarrua/105254)
Jet UAV detected in Poltava region near Hlobyne heading west. (Source: @eRadarrua/105298)
Ballistic missile threat: Iskander-M launch possible from Taganrog, Rostov region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70179)
Ukrainian air defense monitoring channels reporting real-time UAV tracks and warnings. (Source: @kpszsu/72686, @mon1tor_ua/70178)

key_developments: Russian Shahed drone struck passenger train in Odesa region killing two crew members; 340 passengers evacuated unharmed before impact. (Source: @UkraineNow/83406)
Ukraine repatriated 261 bodies of likely Ukrainian servicemen; Russia received 24 bodies in simultaneous exchange. (Source: @UkraineNow/83403, @ukr_leaks_eng/32421)

Russian forces advanced in Markov area per DeepState map; Ukrainian DSU liberated 745 sq km and 26 villages in Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia since January. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23737, @UkraineNow/83394)
SBU uncovered 14-agent Russian network using Lviv aviation blogger to recruit spotters near airbases targeting F-16 and Mirage 2000; blocked 4 channels and 10 groups. (Source: @UkraineNow/83413)
Russia plans to abolish border zones with occupied Ukrainian territories in Rostov, Voronezh regions and Crimea, moving border regime to external boundaries. (Source: @UkraineNow/83410)
Germany and Czechia ending temporary protection for Ukrainian conscription-age men who didn't fulfill military duty; new EU Council decision effective Aug 4. (Source: @UkraineNow/83415)

Russian overnight drone waves targeted 9+ Ukrainian regions; ballistic missile threat from Taganrog; strikes on Odesa port fuel tanks and Ochakiv patrol boat claimed. (Source: @kpszsu/72692, @mon1tor_ua/70179, @tass_agency/390169)
sections.threat_assessment: Russian drone campaign demonstrates sustained capacity for mass Shahed/jet UAV launches across broad front, targeting civilian infrastructure (train, logistics) and military assets (airfields, ports). The Iskander-M threat from Taganrog indicates continued ballistic missile readiness. SBU's exposure of 14-agent network targeting F-16/Mirage 2000 suggests Russian intelligence prioritizing attrition of Western-supplied air assets. Russia's border zone abolition signals administrative consolidation of occupied territories. Ukrainian DSU gains in east (745 sq km) show offensive momentum but at high cost (9,550 Russian KIA claimed). Western partner policy shifts (Germany, Czechia) may pressure Ukrainian manpower.
sections.regional_response: Germany's termination of temporary protection for non-compliant Ukrainian men aligns with EU Council decision, potentially increasing pressure on Kyiv to mobil
